claim: XDC computes the stated Chinese-restaurant-process prior over order-free rule types exactly
population: 216 random n<=5 cases (4 bases, h=1/2, clamps, edits) + 60 relabelling cases per base
endpoint: max abs difference to an independent closed-form Polya-urn oracle sharing no code
evidence: 2.9e-12 max (float bound 1.5e-13 per term x 1,296 terms); planted (|b|-1)! defect fails 12/24 cases (max 0.19); reports/R6_XDC_AUDIT.md
limits: small n only; oracle enumerates mechanisms; interface returns P(node=1)

claim: XDC beats the calibration-selected flat code (gate) on held-out synthetic n=8 worlds
population: 320 worlds, 8 strata, 280 groups (r6-g-eval-v1, locked by reviewer at 246d3cd)
evidence: +0.0149 [0.0088,0.0211]; median world +0.0002; top 10% of worlds carry 109% of net gain; reports/R6_GENERALIZATION.md
limits: synthetic generators; gain confined to the four strata built with rule reuse (+0.042 [0.032,0.052]); outside them -0.012 [-0.019,-0.005]; lock target 0.02 not met

claim: XDC beats gate on fresh fragments of published models at n=8
limits: small; sharing part +0.0011 [-0.0002,0.0023] not separable from 0; 31% of nodes constant from clamping

claim: A learned rule-type mixture (XDC-EB, certified fit) beats the best flat code on published-model fragments of 24 nodes
evidence: +0.0087 [0.0037,0.0148]; no missing outcomes; 63% of worlds favour method; reports/R6_SCALE.md
limits: pilot-scale effect (<0.01); every lineage seen in an n=8 panel; no dose-response with reuse (r=-0.05); B16 at ceiling (-0.0004)

disconfirming_evidence: intact null; ladder not monotone at B8 or B16
